name: The Investigator
design: Smooth high-density dark brown duster, lowered hat with downturned front brim, featureless shadowed face. 1990s Appalachian horror investigator.
surface_style: Smooth shaded, rounded edges, subdivided garments and hat

Idle.description: Quiet breathing and a small head/coat sway.

Walk.description: Measured walking with planted stance feet.

Jump.description: Anticipation, takeoff, tucked airborne pose, landing and recovery.

Crouch.description: Held crouch with subtle breathing; both feet grounded.

Slide.description: Crouch to a low slide with one leg extended, returning to crouch.

CriticalWalk.description: Hunched, asymmetric limp with the left hand bracing the abdomen.

Run.description: In-place run, retained from the original pack.

Interact.description: Right-hand reach and recovery, retained from the original pack.

root_motion: None. Slide is stationary horizontally; game controller supplies travel.
jump_motion: Local hips provide a 0.42 m visual arc; match or remove this channel for a physics-driven jump.
